title: mRemoteNG always opens on monitor 2
author: n3cr0cr0w
body_snippet:
Description
mRemoteNG always opens on monitor 2, even when it is launched from the Start menu on monitor 1.

Nightly Build
Version: v1.83.0
Date: 20260817
Commit: [80f7a96]

Installed from: [mRemoteNG-nightly-20260817-v1.83.0-80f7a96-x64.msi]


I only use mRemoteNG on monitor 1, so this does not appear to be caused by restoring a previously saved window position. The application is not intentionally used on monitor 2.
